servinfo.title: LED Headlight Description
servinfo.ptxt: The LED headlight is composed of LED for low beam and high beam. The main components of LED headlight are LED, reflector, heat sink and LED control module, and have the following features.

item.ptxt: With an LED headlight, light is dispersed evenly compared with a discharge headlight. Further, the brightness of LED is similar to the sunlight and illuminates frontward brightly.

LED headlights do not have arc tube unlike discharge headlight and their useful life is longer and not affected by ON/OFF switching. Further, LED maintains stable luminance over long periods and offers advantages for maintenance too.

servinfosub.title: LED Headlight Control System
servinfosub.ptxt: The LED headlight unit is comprised of LED (1), reflector (low-beam side (2) and high-beam side (3)), heat sink (4), HI/LO switching motor (5), movable shade (6), cooling fan (7) and LED control module (8).

item.ptxt: The LED control module is built into the headlight assembly, and performs the LED lighting On / Off control, LED disconnection detection and cooling fan On / Off control.

For headlight auto leveling model, if the LED control module detects a disconnection of the LED, it sends a disconnection detection signal to the headlight auto leveling control module. Furthermore, after detecting a failure of the cooling fan, the LED control module decreases the current supplied to the LED to keep the LED headlight lit.

servinfosub.title: Heat Sink
servinfosub.ptxt: Using cooling fan, forcedly radiates heat generated in LED.

servinfosub.title: Cooling Fan
servinfosub.ptxt: Restricts rise of temperature in LED control module and internal circuit.

topic.title: Low beam
topic.ptxt: When the lighting switch is LO, the HI/LO switching motor (4) does not operate. As the movable shade (1) is fixed in a position where light from the reflector (the high-beam side) (2) is blocked, the light passes through the reflector (the low-beam side) (3), forming a low beam optical axis.

topic.title: High beam
topic.ptxt: When the lighting switch is HI, the HI/LO switching motor (4) operates, causing the movable shade (1) to tilt. The light then passes between the reflector (the low-beam side) (3) and the reflector (the high-beam side) (2), forming a high beam optical axis.

servinfosub.title: Self-Diagnosis Function (Headlight Auto Leveling Model)
servinfosub.ptxt: When the LED and/or LED control module malfunctions, the LED headlight warning light (1) in the combination meter (2) comes on to warn the driver of the trouble.
